plugins.name: ddaa
plugins.description: Skills (EN) — brief, preflight, proof, bilingual skill creator, bookkeeping.

plugins.name: ddaa-fr
plugins.description: Skills (FR) — brief, preflight, relecture, saisie comptable.

plugins.name: ddaa-handoff
plugins.description: Resume-summary handoff (EN) — end-of-session summary to continue in a new chat, delivered to Notion when available. Enable this OR the lightweight `handoff` plugin, not both.

plugins.name: ddaa-passation
plugins.description: Passation résumé de session (FR) — résumé de fin de session pour continuer dans un nouveau chat, livré sur Notion quand c'est disponible. Activer celui-ci OU le plugin `handoff` léger, pas les deux.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Task snapshot that survives a /clear or /compact in Claude Code: the agent writes the current task, open decisions, and remaining todos to a local file, and a SessionStart hook injects it verbatim into the next session. Also names the session and drives an attended compact-and-continue.

plugins.name: gitmoji
plugins.description: Commit-msg git hook that replaces conventional-commit prefixes (feat:, fix:, docs:, ...) with gitmoji emojis. Ships an installer command that stows the hook into the current git repo.

plugins.name: gitlore
plugins.description: Versioned, shared, git-backed memory for Claude Code.

plugins.name: onekeys
plugins.description: UserPromptSubmit hook that expands single-character prompts into full instructions (c → Continue, h → /handoff:handoff). Mappings live in ~/.claude/onekeyers.txt.

plugins.name: cwd-safety
plugins.description: Keeps the agent's Bash working directory at project root: a PreToolUse(Bash) hook blocks drift-inducing `cd` commands and commands run from a drifted cwd; a PostToolUse(Bash) hook warns after the working directory changes.

plugins.name: unsandbox-git-status
plugins.description: Forces `git status` to run with the Claude Code command sandbox disabled, so it reports the real working tree instead of phantom sandbox-mount entries.

plugins.name: candidature
plugins.description: Candidature assistée : préparation, lettre de motivation, CV adapté, relecture, suivi des retours. Stockage Notion. Contenu français.

plugins.name: shell-scripting
plugins.description: Shell scripting gotchas skill plus automatic shellcheck feedback on edited shell files
